dataset_info.name: gameops-chatbot-paper-grounded-15-v1
dataset_info.description: 15-item focused evaluation dataset: 5 document-grounded RAG questions, 5 structured DB log questions, and 5 multi-hop RAG questions. Cases are grounded in current DB documents and operation log fixtures.
paper_basis: RAGAS: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation (EACL 2024)
StructGPT: A General Framework for LLM to Reason over Structured Data (2023)
ChatLR: Redefining Information Retrieval of Structured Database via LLMs (2025)
Enhancing Few-shot Text-to-SQL Capabilities of LLMs (2023)
dataset_info.evaluation_note: Run RAGAS only for metadata.requires_rag=true. Structured DB cases should be evaluated with route/action/tool/evidence accuracy rather than RAGAS document metrics.
dataset_info.rubric_note: outputs.rubrics contains per-instance criteria for custom LangSmith evaluators such as answer_relevancy and instance_rubrics. RAGAS metrics still use reference_answer and retrieved_contexts.
dataset_info.reference_answer_note: reference_answer is intentionally concise for RAGAS factual correctness; detailed grading criteria live in outputs.key_points and outputs.rubrics.
